recommendations: Retain Tailwind CSS and vanilla JavaScript with German/English content and future cms.xms integration.
Use checklist to update identity, global header/footer, navigation and offering-specific enquiry flows.
Add Photography under 1:1; rename Schamanisches Retreat display title to We're the ones we've been waiting for while preserving URL compatibility.
Curate hero, portrait sequences, 4–6 photographs per retreat, and a dedicated music gallery; avoid duplicate-heavy wholesale import.
Keep large testimonial portraits/names and calm crossfades; tag testimonials by offering, with a shared retreat pool.
Separate historical retreat imagery from confirmed future editions; use interest/waitlist calls to action where dates are unconfirmed.
Prioritize functional enquiry/waitlist flows; distinguish course purchase enquiry from actual checkout.
Gather Telegram URL, logo master, offering-specific testimonials and portrait attribution, Photography/Reading copy, confirmed future dates and newsletter/order integration details.
Convert HEIC/NEF to web formats, deduplicate imports, preserve source IDs and per-image subject/crop/alt/credit metadata.
